post_clip.description: A person exits a dark SUV and appears to interact aggressively with another individual near the vehicle; the second person is seen crouching or being pushed down beside the car (frames 7–11), suggesting possible assault or robbery. No explosion occurs, but violent physical confrontation is evident.

A person is seen interacting with the open fuel door and rear of a vehicle at a gas pump; by frame 9–10, the person has disappeared from view and the vehicle appears heavily distorted/collapsed inward near the fuel area, suggesting a sudden violent event (likely an explosion or fireball) consistent with fuel ignition—no bright flash is visible due to low-resolution/night conditions, but the abrupt structural deformation and disappearance of the person indicate a catastrophic incident.

Sudden ignition of fire at the rear passenger side of a vehicle while a person stands nearby; flame erupts rapidly and intensely (frames 8–11), consistent with an explosive or flash fire event—matches expected anomaly type of explosion/flash fire (bright flash, rapid flame growth, no prior visible ignition source).
